renderer.scope: Isolated rendering of a prepared UPM graph with GOMAXPROCS=4. Each benchmark invocation first verifies exact expected scripts.nix bytes. Seven alternating trials plus warmups; twenty iterations per invocation. Excludes Go discovery, Nix evaluation and builds.
renderer.allocation_measurement_scope: Fixed-order ten-iteration full exporter benchmark with compact planning toolchain and prepared modules; allocation counters only, not a latency comparison or peak-memory measurement.

standalone.scope: Warm standalone UPM export, prepared modules, explicit full toolchain; output replacement is included; GOMAXPROCS controls both exporter and Go subprocesses. No realization.

data.scope: dynamic evaluation + realization; fresh planner, warm tools and Go package outputs; cache metadata queries follow the selected Nix settings
